purpose: Explicit source review for tensor bulk/diffusion support and test-only dependency correction, followed by current posterior/gradient checks; original producer manifests, draws and uncertainty calculations are retained.

src/PopulationBalanceModels.jl.review: Preserves the previous stationary/Gauss–Newton additions; includes the new tensor-only diagonal diffusion methods. No replacement of one-coordinate transport, likelihood, priors or posterior definitions.

src/inference/bayesian_diagnostics.jl.review: Retains opt-in Gauss–Newton support and adds stationary/mixed backend labels only after existing explicit finite-difference, callback and SciML choices. Transient gradient, Hessian, likelihood and posterior definitions unchanged.

src/inference/statistical_model.jl.review: Timed measurements delegate their unchanged validation/likelihood setup to a shared helper. Adds timeless measurements and stationary family dispatch; existing transient solution body is unchanged. Adds eligible one-dimensional HOC histogram support; the retained sectional protein calculation uses its unchanged path.

ext/PopulationBalanceModelsOptimExt.jl.review: Adds opt-in uncertainty=:gauss_newton after MAP optimization. Default uncertainty=:none, optimizer and statistical target unchanged.

src/inference/gauss_newton.jl.review: New opt-in fixed-Gaussian sensitivity covariance calculation. No forward residual, likelihood, prior, sampler or solver replacement.

src/inference/observations.jl.review: Retains the prior timeless/axial observation additions. Adds an explicit rejection for a tensor passed to the one-coordinate histogram API, before accessing grid.centers. Retained one-coordinate CDF/bulk/quantile calculations are unchanged.

src/inference/calibration.jl.review: Adds stationary legacy-calibration dispatch and rejects timeless blocks in transient experiments. Existing Bayesian protein estimation does not use CalibrationProblem; existing timed calibration residuals remain unchanged.

src/inference/differentiation.jl.review: Adds only the default _is_stationary trait returning false. Existing transient problem lifting and automatic differentiation formulas are unchanged.

src/inference/distribution_discrepancies.review: Adds timeless discrepancy constructors; original timed residual, conditional CDF/quantile calculations and Wasserstein diagnostics remain unchanged.

src/stationary/problems.jl.review: Adds documentation of stationary estimation and converts only closure state-validation ArgumentError to NumericalFailure for invalid stationary trials. No transient path or protein model/likelihood uses this code.

src/inference/stationary.jl.review: New opt-in stationary inference and direct observation methods. Checked equilibrium roots and implicit derivatives dispatch exclusively on StationaryPBMProblem; no replacement of transient residuals, integration, priors or posterior definitions.

src/numerics/sectional/size_diffusion.jl.review: Broadens compile-time geometry validation to Grid2D and extracts the identical geometry computation to a helper. The complete one-coordinate flux, coefficient evaluation, uniform-coefficient optimization and return values are unchanged.

src/coupling/systems.jl.review: Adds representation-shaped tensor views and residual dispatch. One-coordinate populations still return the identical flat views and reshape to the same one-column states. Factors the unchanged one-coordinate exchange sum, selected loss correction and ledger check into _exchange_amount, with a separate tensor specialization.

src/compilation/tensor.jl.review: Adds Grid2D bulk context, shaped accessors/exchange, diagonal diffusion timestep contributions, and primal-value initial-state validation for AD. These methods dispatch on CompiledPBM2D and are not used by the retained one-coordinate protein problems.

src/compilation/axial_system.jl.review: Retains the reviewed axial packing refactor and accepts tensor populations without intrinsic diffusion. Batch protein problems use no axial adapter; the existing intrinsic-diffusion rejection remains in place.

src/modeling/terms.jl.review: Extends the SizeDiffusion docstring to describe the implemented diagonal tensor contract; no term structures, one-coordinate constructors, mechanism identifiers or callbacks changed.

src/numerics/policies.jl.review: Documents transverse-width scaling in Grid2D FiniteVolumeDiffusion. Method types and the one-coordinate numerical contract are unchanged.

src/numerics/tensor/size_diffusion.jl.review: New Grid2D-only diagonal Ito finite-volume methods, with nonnegative coefficients and conservative face fluxes. No one-coordinate dispatch, posterior or observation formula is overridden.
